name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold and silver explorer with a strategic land and royalty position concentrated in Nevada, including the Loman, Agai-Pah, and Belshazzar projects. The company is in the exploration stage and also acquires mineral royalties and engages in precious metals streaming. Headquartered in Reno, Nevada, NGLD trades on the OTCQX market.
